priorities: Evaluate each state's guards in listed order; only the first matching guard executes.
Jam overrides every other input, including Reset.
Reset without Jam returns any state to IDLE.
An existing FAULT remains latched without an effective Reset; Stop cannot clear it.
Stop overrides normal transitions; otherwise use the state-specific transition or hold.
All inputs are level-sensitive. Execute at most one state transition per scan.

initial_values.scope: Fresh instance before the first scan; the first scan executes normally.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample Start, Stop, AtExit, Jam and Reset once into scan-local values. Use sampled levels directly; no edge detection is required.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Read the retained pre-state and apply the first matching guard. Commit exactly one resulting state without re-evaluating transitions.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FBs are required, so this stage has no calls.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign Belt := (state = MOVING), Complete := (state = COMPLETE), and Fault := (state = FAULT) from the post-transition state.
